name: Black Tides: The Curse of Blackbeard
storyline:
The Golden Age of Piracy is fading, but the legend of Blackbeard refuses to die. Edward Teach Jr has grown up carrying the weight of a father he never knew—the most notorious pirate captain to sail the Caribbean, Blackbeard. When a long-buried map reveals that Blackbeard survived the battle history claims ended him, Edward seizes command of his ship for a monumental quest: a son’s journey to find his father and claim the vast treasure hidden as his final gift—a fortune powerful enough to reshape empires.

But Edward sails into a storm of enemies and whispers of something darker that clings to the Teach name. Ruthless Admiral Blackwood and Vice Admiral Maynard of the British Empire will stop at nothing to seize the treasure and crush the freedom of the New World, while rival pirate captains hunger for Blackbeard’s legacy.
A breathtaking cinematic epic of bloodline, sacrifice, and destiny, Black Tides: The Curse of Blackbeard tells the story of one man confronting his father’s shadow to forge his own legend on the black tides of history.
summary: Black Tides: The Curse of Blackbeard is a cinematic open-world pirate epic set in the Caribbean, built in Unreal Engine 5.
